investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Redmark Assurance (insurance); Platform: Google Cloud us-east4 (zones us-east4-a/us-east4-b/us-east4-c); network range 10.95.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster redmar-prod-useast (GKE); Caching tier: self-managed Redis (cache-redis-03, maxmemory 4gb, allkeys-lru) in front of the quotes-svc PostgreSQL database quotes-db-01; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
